description:
A modern and secure instant messaging for people, business and healthcare


[Feature] Chat Window: Attach several pictures at once by dropping or inserting them
[Feature] Chat Window: Multiple files or folders now compress into a single archive when sent
[Feature] Chat Window: New toggle to send images in-line or as attachments
[Feature] History: View a day as text even when chat history is in the cloud
[Feature] Notifications: Sounds for outgoing reactions and reaction removals, with a single sound setting
[Feature] Status: Choose the hour when status messages clear
[Changed] Spell Check: Updated the English autocorrect rules
[Fixed] Chat Window: Clearer error when dropping files while file sharing is disabled
[Fixed] Chat Window: Dropped files fall back to peer-to-peer when server hosting is unavailable
[Fixed] Chat Window: Fixed an intermittent crash when opening windows
[Fixed] Chat Window: Fixed an issue where some HTML-encoded text could display incorrectly
[Fixed] Chat Window: Fixed messages that could not be deleted
[Fixed] Chat Window: Fixed outgoing message sounds and events sometimes not firing
[Fixed] Chat Window: Fixed undo in the message box not always restoring text
[Fixed] Chat Window: In-line images now highlight when selected
[Fixed] Contact List: Conversation tabs now group under the contact's visible group
[Fixed] Contact List: Fixed new contacts sometimes filing into the wrong group
[Fixed] Contact List: Fixed tab settings being lost after upgrading
[Fixed] Emoticons: Fixed clearing a GIF search not restoring trending results
[Fixed] Emoticons: Fixed the emoticon button reopening the picker instead of closing it
[Fixed] Emoticons: Recently used emoticons no longer shuffle while the picker is open
[Fixed] General: Fixed a rare crash when deleting an account
[Fixed] History: Fixed an issue saving images from the timeline
[Fixed] History: Fixed the search box position when searching all conversations
[Fixed] History: Fixed the View button position on the Images view
[Fixed] Installer: Clearer errors for missing or damaged installation files
[Fixed] Installer: Fixed Trillian failing to load when components were not signed
[Fixed] Installer: Silent installs no longer stall behind hidden error dialogs
[Fixed] Media: Fixed canceled downloads leaving images partially grey
[Fixed] Media: Fixed previews for links whose web address contains encoded characters
[Fixed] Media: Fixed sending media to contacts on other domains sometimes failing
[Fixed] Media: Fixed the same image downloading twice corrupting its cached copy
[Fixed] Media: Saving images now follows the domain media sharing policy
[Fixed] Notifications: Fixed duplicate reaction sounds after upgrading
[Fixed] Notifications: Fixed reaction sound settings not surviving a restart
[Fixed] Sign In: Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the sign-in window
[Fixed] Sign In: Fixed Cancel closing Trillian instead of returning to the sign-in screen after a two-factor retry
[Fixed] Sign In: Fixed a denied or expired two-factor push leaving sign-in stuck
[Fixed] Sign In: Fixed label alignment while a two-factor push is pending
[Fixed] Spell Check: Fixed autocorrect only working in English
[Fixed] Spell Check: Fixed autocorrect occasionally replacing words with unrelated text
[Fixed] Spell Check: Fixed regional languages (like British English) not spell checking
